about: Short muted looping clips for the docs, made by docs/scripts/record.py. Paths are relative to the site's base URL (public/). Embed with

clips.name: snake
clips.title: Snake
clips.description: The Snake game from examples/games: a fixed-rate loop steering toward the food.

clips.name: breakout
clips.title: Breakout
clips.description: Breakout from examples/games: a ball, a paddle that follows it and bricks that break.

clips.name: neon-invaders
clips.title: Neon Invaders
clips.description: Neon Invaders from examples/games: waves, shots, explosions and power-ups.

clips.name: game-of-life
clips.title: Game of Life
clips.description: Conway's Game of Life drawn on a canvas, one generation every few frames.

clips.name: game-first
clips.title: Coin Chase
clips.description: examples/games/coin_chase.py: an orb steered with held keys collects coins.

clips.name: game-sprites
clips.title: Walker
clips.description: examples/games/walker.py: frame animation, flipping, a tweened jump and coins that pop.

clips.name: game-jump-arc
clips.title: Jump Lab
clips.description: examples/games/jump_lab.py: gravity, a jump arc traced by the debug view, box collisions and bouncing balls.

clips.name: game-platformer
clips.title: Pixel Run
clips.description: examples/games/platformer.py: a tile map, a following camera, coins and slimes to stomp.

clips.name: game-asteroids
clips.title: Rock Storm
clips.description: examples/games/asteroids.py: thrust, wrap-around space, rocks that split and particles everywhere.

clips.name: game-2048
clips.description: examples/games/game_2048.py: tiles slide, merge with a pop, and the score floats up.

clips.name: game-menus
clips.title: Orb Rush menus
clips.description: examples/games/menus.py: the title menu slides in, the game runs with its HUD, pauses, and the settings open.

clips.name: game-high-scores
clips.title: Target Rush
clips.description: examples/games/high_scores.py: click the targets, enter a name, and the leaderboard is saved.

clips.name: concept-particles
clips.title: Particles
clips.description: Four ways to use game.Particles: an explosion, a fountain, glowing sparks and a trail.

clips.name: concept-collisions
clips.title: Box and circle collisions
clips.description: AABB overlap, the push-out along the shortest axis, and a ball bouncing off a box with game.circle_rect.

clips.name: concept-easing
clips.title: Easing curves
clips.description: Four tweens over the same second: linear, ease-out, ease-in-out and ease-out-back.

clips.name: concept-juice
clips.title: Juice
clips.description: The same hit, plain and with juice: hit-stop, a flash, particles, screen shake and a squash.

clips.name: shaders
clips.title: Shader graphs
clips.description: Six node-based shaders from examples/showcase/shaders running at once.

clips.name: themes
clips.title: One app, six themes
clips.description: The component gallery (examples/gallery.py) switching between built-in themes.

clips.name: designer-themes
clips.title: Pyzed Design in other themes
clips.description: Pyzed Design's own look following the theme picked in Settings.

clips.name: form-validation
clips.title: A form validating as you type
clips.description: The login form made in Pyzed Design: a wrong email is flagged, fixed, then Sign in runs its progress.

clips.name: designer-place-controls
clips.title: Placing controls from the toolbox
clips.description: Pyzed Design: a button, a text box and a check box dragged from the toolbox onto an empty form.

clips.name: designer-tabs-anywhere
clips.title: Tabs anywhere
clips.description: Pyzed Design: the Events panel dragged next to the forms, a form dragged into the left dock and both dragged back, with the target lit up and a copy of the tab under the pointer.

clips.name: shader-graph
clips.title: Building a shader graph
clips.description: Pyzed Design's Shader view: Voronoi and Palette nodes dragged in and wired to the Output, with live previews.

clips.name: shader-preview
clips.title: A shader's Preview tab
clips.description: The Preview tab of the Shader view: the glow ring pulsing as time runs.

clips.name: hover
clips.title: Hover, press and toggle
clips.description: Pyzed controls reacting to a real pointer: hover and press states, a tooltip, a switch, a check box, a slider.
